Item 1. Business

ACME Utility Corp ("the Company" or "ACME") is a vertically integrated electric utility holding company. ITEM1_PREAMBLE_TOKEN_ALPHA. The Company continues to expand generation capacity to serve data-center load growth. Additional risk factors are discussed in Item 1A below and should be read carefully in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements.

The Company operates in a single reportable segment and serves approximately 1.2 million retail customers across its regulated service territory.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

ITEM1A_BODY_TOKEN_BETA. Our business is subject to numerous risks, including Risk & Uncertainty Factors related to interconnection queue delays, wildfire liability, and rising interest rates. A prolonged delay in large-load interconnection approvals could materially affect Company Holdings' projected capital expenditures.
